parent_models.justification: IRM (Invariant Risk Minimization) and SHIR (Semantic Hierarchical Invariant Risk Minimization) might be conceptually similar, as both could deal with invariant risk minimization.

closest_parent_model.justification: IRM is the closest semantically to a potential SHIR concept due to the focus on invariant risk minimization.

child_models.justification: ER (Empirical Risk) could be a specific instance or component within a broader SHIR framework, focusing on empirical risks.

closest_child_model.justification: ER is the closest child model as it directly relates to risk, which SHIR may also focus on.

sibling_models.justification: ERM (Empirical Risk Minimization) is related but not equivalent and would share the closest parent category with SHIR potentially dealing with risk minimization.

closest_sibling_model.justification: ERM is the closest sibling model as it also focuses on risk minimization.

unrelated_models.justification: UPR does not seem to have any evident connection to SHIR or risk minimization.
DANN is unrelated to SHIR as it focuses on domain adversarial neural networks.
DANNS is a variant of DANN, and therefore unrelated to SHIR.
SUT is unrelated as it typically refers to something like Structural Unit Testing.
DETR is a model for detection and is unrelated to SHIR.
FF does not appear to relate to risk minimization or hierarchical models.
SPR is unrelated to SHIR as it does not seem to connect to the theme.
CHITF has no evident connection to SHIR.
SVR (Support Vector Regression) usually relates to regression tasks, hence unrelated.

KRR (Kernel Ridge Regression) is a regression technique, unrelated to SHIR.
